title: High-speed non-volatile barium titanate field-programmable photonic gate array
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 04 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01934-y

Barium titanate ferroelectric is used in photonic phase shifters arranged in a hexagonal waveguide mesh, forming a programmable photonic array. The device achieves sub-100-ns switching speeds, while each individual gate retains its state without continuous powering, enhancing overall energy efficiency.

title: Orbital angular momentum multiplexing diffractive neural networks for high-capacity optical inference
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 04 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01930-2

By exploiting optical angular momentum and developing an end-to-end auto-optimization strategy to achieve 14-fold higher mode utilization compared with manual encoding, a deep diffractive neural network enables multitask recognition of 100 object categories with an average accuracy of 72.7%.

title: Quantum coherent beating in polar disubphthalocyanine-fullerene cocrystals for ultrafast photothermal conversion
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 04 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01912-4

Quantum coherent beating and ultrafast energy transfer have been observed in a polar disubphthalocyanine-fullerene cocrystal. The temperature reached 228 °C within 5 s following 0.5 W cm−2 laser irradiation, and an equilibrium temperature of 242 °C was achieved, which is higher than those of many other organic solids.

title: Single-shot full-field X-ray imaging with 10-nm resolution using hard X-ray free-electron laser pulses
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 03 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01913-3

Using X-ray free-electron laser pulses with mirror optics to generate a sub-10-nm focal spot and an algorithm to compensate for fluctuations in illumination, this study demonstrates single-shot in-line holography for femtosecond imaging with a field of view exceeding 1 μm and a spatial resolution of 10 nm.

title: Crystalline symmetry breaking enables directional light emission in quantum dots
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 02 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01935-x

Stacking faults enhance light out-coupling efficiency in zinc-blende quantum dot light-emitting diodes. The authors report external quantum efficiencies of 34.3% and 31.0% for green CdZnSe- and InP-based quantum dot light-emitting diodes, respectively.

title: Ternary self-assembled molecular contact for ambient-processed perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 01 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01925-z

A new ternary self-assembled molecular contact enables the fabrication of perovskite solar cells in ambient conditions, with perovskite/silicon tandem devices achieving a power conversion efficiency of 31.72%.

title: Omnidirectional ionic locking network for stable perovskite photovoltaics
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 29 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01918-y

Infiltrating a bifunctional spacer between perovskite grain boundaries enables perovskite solar cells with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.01%, 90% of which is maintained after over 2,000 h of operation.

title: An on-chip programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuit
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 25 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01916-0

An on-chip light-programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuit enabled by meta-waveguide photodetectors integrated with transition metal dichalcogenides is demonstrated. In situ generation, selective routing and electrical readout of valley-dependent chiral photons are achieved.
